name: FHIR R4 conformance and data quality

rules.title: FHIR R4 capability discovery
rules.description: Verifies that metadata returns a successful FHIR R4 CapabilityStatement.
rules.remediation: Expose a FHIR R4 CapabilityStatement from the metadata endpoint.

rules.title: FHIR JSON content type
rules.description: Requires FHIR responses to advertise the application/fhir+json media type.
rules.remediation: Return application/fhir+json for JSON-encoded FHIR resources.

rules.title: Search pagination links
rules.description: Checks Bundle self and next links against the returned page and total.
rules.remediation: Emit coherent absolute self and next links for paginated search Bundles.

rules.title: Date and timezone precision
rules.description: Checks representative FHIR dateTime values for explicit timezone offsets.
rules.remediation: Preserve an explicit UTC or numeric offset on every value containing a time.

rules.title: Reference integrity
rules.description: Verifies that representative synthetic resource references resolve.
rules.remediation: Correct missing, malformed, or cross-boundary references before exchange.

rules.title: Terminology binding validity
rules.description: Verifies coded synthetic values against the scenario's pinned terminology assertions.
rules.remediation: Use codes from the required value set and pin the terminology package version.

rules.title: Narrative markup safety
rules.description: Checks that generated synthetic narrative excludes unsafe active markup.
rules.remediation: Sanitize generated XHTML and reject scripts, event handlers, and unsafe URLs.

rules.title: Modifier extension handling
rules.description: Verifies that representative modifier extensions are recognized or explicitly rejected rather than ignored.
rules.remediation: Reject unsupported modifier extensions and implement the semantics of supported modifiers.

rules.title: Unknown extension preservation
rules.description: Verifies that unknown non-modifier extensions survive a deterministic synthetic round trip.
rules.remediation: Preserve unknown non-modifier extensions when reading and re-serializing resources.
